Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), November volume, plate for the 6th, filed by Commons under Category:Paul I of Constantinople. 6 November is Paul I the Confessor, archbishop of Constantinople, strangled in exile - the folder's patriarch and confessor, whose display name is Paul of Constantinople. Not the apostle Paul (29 June), not Paul of Thebes (15 January) and not Paul of Komel, each of which has its own plate in the series.
